svg.title: Full RecycleScan pipeline
svg.desc: End-to-end flow from TACO dataset through training, deployment, and a live user scan to the final recyclability verdict

g.text: Phase 1 — offline training (you do this once on your machine)

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What does the TACO dataset contain?')
sendPrompt('What does preprocess.py do for TACO to YOLO conversion?')
sendPrompt('How does YOLOv8 training work with the TACO dataset?')
sendPrompt('How do I evaluate a YOLOv8 model trained on TACO?')
g.text: evaluate.py — check mAP, per-class accuracy, confusion matrix
iterate: if accuracy is poor, add more data or tune hyperparameters, retrain

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How do I load YOLOv8 model once at FastAPI startup?')
sendPrompt('What does recycling_rules.json look like for RecycleScan?')
sendPrompt('How does the React Native camera capture work for RecycleScan?')
sendPrompt('How should I compress images in React Native before upload?')
sendPrompt('How do I POST a file from React Native to FastAPI?')
sendPrompt('What does yolo_service.py do when it receives an image?')
g.text: resize → normalize → forward pass → parse boxes → filter conf > 0.5

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How does classifier.py decide if something is recyclable?')
g.text: "plastic bottle" → recyclable: true, reason, misconception tip

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What JSON response should POST /scan return to React Native?')
sendPrompt('What should ResultScreen display in RecycleScan?')
